# Kevin Jojo

> AI Engineer & Product-Focused Builder based in Cochin, Kerala, India — designing and deploying LLM-powered applications, evaluation frameworks, and multi-modal prediction systems that solve real-world business problems.

Kevin Jojo is an AI Engineer specializing in Large Language Models, Generative AI, Machine Learning, Python, MLOps, and Data Science. He builds production-grade AI systems, including the Advanced Medical Report Analyzer, and shares his work through projects, LinkedIn posts, and live AI demos.

- Education: Karunya University; De Paul Public School (2019–2021, Class 11–12); Village International School (2007–2019)
- Email: kevinjojo003@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kevinjojo/
- GitHub: https://github.com/Kevinjojo2003
